// Combine the lead with the AI answer into one Google Sheet row
const lead = $('Build AI prompt').item.json.lead;
const ai = $input.first().json.output || {};

return [{ json: {
  date: lead.date,
  niche: lead.niche,
  city: lead.city,
  business_name: lead.business_name,
  category: lead.category,
  rating: lead.rating,
  reviews: lead.reviews,
  phone: lead.phone,
  website: lead.website,
  maps_url: lead.maps_url,
  gaps: Array.isArray(ai.gaps) ? ai.gaps.join('; ') : (ai.gaps || ''),

  email_subject: ai.email_subject || '',

parameters.content:
# START HERE
## Client Hunter by Mehshum Asif

Give it a **niche** and a **city**. It finds businesses on Google Maps, checks their website, and writes a **personal email + WhatsApp/DM message** for each one. Everything lands in your Google Sheet.

---
### One time setup (15 min)

**1. Apify (finds businesses)**
Free account at apify.com
Settings > API & Integrations > copy token
Open **Find businesses (Apify)** > Credential > Create new > paste token

**2. Gemini (the AI brain)**
Free key at aistudio.google.com > Get API key
Open **Gemini** node > Credential > Create new > paste key

**3. Google Sheet (where leads go)**
Make a sheet, rename the tab to **Leads**, add the headers from the PDF guide
Open **Save to Google Sheet** > sign in with Google > pick your sheet and the Leads tab

**4. Save the workflow**

---
### Run it
Click **Execute workflow** > fill the form > Submit
Start with **3 leads** to test.

Full guide: see the PDF that came with this file.

## 1. Find businesses
**Form** collects niche, city, number of leads, your service and message language.
**Apify** searches Google Maps (max 20 per run).
**Prepare leads** removes duplicates and keeps only useful fields.

Needs: Apify credential

## 2. Check each website
The loop takes one business at a time.
**Has website?** splits businesses with and without a site.
**Fetch website** opens the site, **Website signals** looks for online booking, live chat, WhatsApp button, contact form and mobile support.

If a site blocks the check, it is marked **unknown** so the AI never makes false claims.

## 3. AI writes the outreach
**Build AI prompt** turns the data into instructions.
**AI analysis** (Gemini) returns:
gaps, a 1 to 10 opportunity score, the best offer, email subject, email body and a short DM.

Needs: Gemini credential

Tip: edit the prompt in **Build AI prompt** to change tone or rules.

## 4. Save to Google Sheet
**Shape sheet row** formats one clean row.
**Save to Google Sheet** adds it to the **Leads** tab.
**Wait 4s** keeps the APIs happy, then the loop picks the next business.

Needs: Google Sheets credential

# Before you send anything

**Always read and edit each message yourself.** The AI writes a draft, you are the one sending it.
Send a few messages a day by hand, not hundreds at once. Spamming gets your email and WhatsApp banned.
Only contact businesses, never personal numbers, and stop if someone says no.

---
# Common errors

**No businesses found**
Check spelling of niche and city, or your Apify token.

**401 / Unauthorized on Apify**
Token is wrong. Recreate the Bearer credential.

**Gemini error or empty AI columns**
Check your Gemini key, or you hit the free limit. Wait a minute and run again.

**Sheet error: column not found**
Tab must be named exactly **Leads** and headers must be in row 1.

**Form does not open**
Allow popups in your browser, keep the n8n tab open while testing.
